get.summary: Display a listing of users with dynamic filters, sorting, sparse fieldsets, and pagination

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Multi-column search across string fields (e.g. name, email).

parameters.name: filter[name]
parameters.description: Filter records by name.

parameters.name: filter[email]
parameters.description: Filter records by email.

parameters.name: filter[created_at_after]
parameters.description: Filter records created on or after date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: filter[created_at_before]
parameters.description: Filter records created on or before date (YYYY-MM-DD).

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Sort by column(s). Prefix with - for descending order. Available: id, name, email, created_at, updated_at. Example: -id,id, -name,name, -email,email

parameters.name: fields
parameters.description: Comma-separated sparse fieldsets to select on the root model (e.g. id,name,email).

parameters.name: include
parameters.description: Comma-separated relationships to eager load without N+1. Available: tokens, media

parameters.name: media
parameters.description: Comma-separated media tags to eager-load in resource responses. Available: profile, avatar, banner, thumbnail, document, attachment, chat, default

parameters.name: fields[tokens]
parameters.description: Comma-separated sparse fieldsets for the 'tokens' relationship.

parameters.name: fields[media]
parameters.description: Comma-separated sparse fieldsets for the 'media' relationship.

parameters.name: append
parameters.description: Comma-separated computed accessors to append dynamically. Available: is_verified, initials, latest_token_name, avatar_url

parameters.name: per_page
parameters.description: Number of items per page (1-100). Default: 15.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Set to -1 to retrieve all matching records in a single unpaginated response.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Page number for standard LengthAware pagination.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Cursor token for high-scale cursor pagination.
